purpose: Teach: 一色/小池/岩田/坂口/大山/山内/浜田/平井

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新任の一色部長を歓迎しろ
lines.en: We're welcoming our new department director, Isshiki, to the company.
lines.style: Commanding, clear delivery. Sharp attack on the opening syllable. Measured pace—each phrase lands with authority. No room for question. Posture upright, chin level.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業の小池課長の出張日程を整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll arrange the sales manager Koike's business trip schedule.
lines.style: Respectful, brisk acknowledgment. Slight nod in the voice at 「はい」. Focused, efficient tone. Professional clarity—stating what will be done without embellishment. Steady breathing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、技術担当の岩田主任にプロジェクトを任せろ
lines.en: Assign the Iwata team lead from our technical division to lead that project.
lines.style: Decisive, measured command. Firm emphasis on the delegation. Composed tone—expecting compliance without needing to enforce it. Shoulders back. Even breath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広報の坂口様の戦略を採用します
lines.en: Understood. I'll adopt the PR strategy that Sakaguchi proposed.
lines.style: Confirmatory, professional. Light upward lilt on 「はい」. Methodical precision—each task absorbed without hesitation. Calm, reliable presence. Slight forward lean of attention.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、顧問の大山様にご助言を仰げ
lines.en: Ask our advisor Oyama for his guidance on this.
lines.style: Respectful direction with underlying weight. Deliberate pacing. The request carries deference without losing authority. Voice settles on each key phrase. Composed handoff.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経理の山内様に決算を依頼します
lines.en: Understood. I'll request that Yamanouchi from accounting handle the closing statements.
lines.style: Efficient acknowledgment. Brisk but not rushed. Professional shorthand—the information is processed and filed. Steady vocal rhythm. Eyes forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、人事の浜田様に新人研修を任せろ
lines.en: Task our HR manager Hamada with overseeing the new-hire training program.
lines.style: Clear allocation of responsibility. Firm but not harsh. Authority without performance. Controlled pace, each assignment deliberate. Voice carries the weight of expectation naturally.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。法務の平井様に契約書確認を依頼します
lines.en: Understood. I'll ask Hirai from legal to review the contracts.
lines.style: Final confirmation, closing the sequence smoothly. Brief, professional. Slight sense of wrapping up—task noted and executed. Calm conclusion. Slight downward inflection at close.
